prompt: Millions of shoppers want a fixed, much smaller seat inventory. What is the waiting room’s main engineering role?

options.text: Meter shoppers into measured booking capacity while serving waiting traffic cheaply
options.explanation: Correct. Admission controls core load; it does not increase the seat supply.

options.text: Let all visitors query the inventory database for queue status
options.explanation: Wrong. This recreates the overload the waiting room should prevent.

options.text: Create more seats by speeding up the seat-map cache
options.explanation: Wrong. Faster reads do not change inventory.

options.text: Guarantee everyone gets tickets by retrying until success
options.explanation: Wrong. Demand exceeds supply, so fair rejection and sold-out feedback are necessary.

workedExample: Keep the crowd’s waiting-page reads separate from authoritative holds. Admit only the work that the inventory and payment dependencies can sustain. Once seats are exhausted, further admission cannot create successful orders.
